topic.title: Sum of Even Numbers
topic.description: Calculates the sum of all even numbers from 1 to 100 using a for loop and modulo filtering. Combines loops with conditional logic.

learningNotes.whatILearned: Using range() with a for loop and the modulo operator to filter only even numbers into a running sum.
learningNotes.challenges: Choosing between range(0,101,2) and a modulo check inside the loop.
learningNotes.nextSteps: Generalize to sum multiples of any number in any range.
